items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: They had, they had a wonderful band and Joe Benuti was the leader of the band.

ctx.x: Anyway, he was playing in that show and I was, I was working with Freddie Rich at the time, see. And, uh, Frankie Cingarillo was playing with them with Joe Benuti and them guys. And, uh, Red Nickel was playing in the pit too with them with them. They had, they had a wonderful band and Joe Benuti was the leader of the band. Crazy Joe. Well, I think that guy used to pull, it was really fun. Anyway, that, that, that was the thing, uh, and I'm trying to think of the name of the show. So, um, well, that doesn't make…

Yeah. Oh, and. Bert Law was in the show. Yeah. Bert Law, he, he lived in, uh, New Jersey City. Well, I can look it up because they've got books about Jimmy Darcy and Tommy Darcy and Red Nickels. Yeah. There's plenty of people that know that. Oh, uh, when the machine was off, you were telling me about your brother going to New York. Yeah. At one time, he was getting booked up there.
